claim: HOFIN is the HALL OF FAME INITIALS DISPLAY routine (*HALL OF FAME INITIALS DISPLAY :242): it (re)draws the 3-character in-progress initials BUFFER while it is being entered — the df7-4 'ENTER INITIALS <buffer>' line maps to it. The persisted multi-row score/initials TABLE above it is df7-4's own un-ported layout, not HOFIN.

source.verbatim: HOFIN	LDX	#$46AC	TOP LEFT OF INITIALS

claim: HOFUL underlines the initials being entered (JSR HOFUL 'UNDERLINE INITIALS') — the df7-4 name-entry render draws the underline beneath the in-progress buffer.

HOFUD is the HALL OF FAME UP DOWN STICK HANDLER (*HALL OF FAME UP DOWN STICK HANDLER :323): the up/down stick CYCLES the currently-selected initial's LETTER (ADDA INIDIR, A-Z wrapping, then redraw) — it does NOT advance the cursor/slot index (INITN), which the separate FIRE-switch handler advances. Mapped in df7-4 onto the @shared/name-entry letter-append keyboard input (the fleet keyboard ruling, not the trackball stick).

source.verbatim: HOFUD	CLR	INIDIR	ZERO INITIALS DIRECTION

claim: HOFAS adds the score and initials to the list (*HALL OF FAME - ADD SCORE AND INITIALS :270) — the df7-4 commit maps onto @shared insertHighScore (CONSUMED, not re-implemented).

source.verbatim: HOFAS	STU	XTEMP$	SAVE TOP OF LIST ADDRESS
